semiconductor_relevance: Low — TIME's focus on high-precision processing technology for non-ferrous metals and Friction Stir Welding (FSW) is not directly aligned with core semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: TIME specializes in high-mix, low-volume manufacturing of high-performance, high-value-added products, focusing on high-precision processing technology for non-ferrous metals. The company designs and manufactures production equipment for diverse products, including smartphones and medical devices, utilizing Friction Stir Welding (FSW) technology to enhance component precision and quality.
capabilities: High-precision processing technology for non-ferrous metals
Friction Stir Welding (FSW) for metal processed parts
Design and manufacture of production equipment for diverse products
